curated_rows.rationale: C17 diagnostic anchor from C16 param 140: one-R target retained, DV20 widened to 2.0B..6.0B, volume lowered only to 1.35..2.0, score window widened to 0.65..0.80 through C17 runtime guard; not a failed-param promotion.
C17 negative-ROC20 sample recovery from C16 param 134 direction: widen score to 0.65..0.80 and DV20 to 2.0B..6.0B while keeping ROC20 cooling and controlled volume.
C17 one-R controlled recovery from C16 param 143 direction: use score 0.68..0.82 only with negative ROC20 and volume 1.35..2.0.
Segmented score 0.70..0.85 test: permits limited 0.80..0.85 only under low ATR and negative ROC20, not a free 0.80..0.90 bucket.
C17 controlled DV20 recovery from C16 param 137: DV20 2.0B..6.0B and score 0.65..0.80, preserving ROC5 pullback and canonical risk/exit constraints.
C17 controlled upper-liquidity recovery from C16 param 141: DV20 to 7.5B and score 0.68..0.82, still segmented by C17 runtime quality floors.
C17 upper-volume test: volume 1.50..2.50 is allowed only with low ATR, negative ROC20, and score 0.68..0.82.
C17 one-R upper-volume segmented test: volume 1.50..2.50 and score 0.70..0.85 only with low ATR and negative ROC20.
C17 score 0.70..0.85 recovery is allowed only under DV20 2.0B..6.0B, ROC20 cooling, and volume 1.35..2.0; 0.85..1.00 remains rejected.
C17 mid-DV20 sample recovery: keeps DV20 2.5B..5B but lowers volume to 1.35 under score 0.65..0.80 and full C17 quality guard.
C17 diagnostic branch from C16 param 134: negative ROC20 with score 0.68..0.82 and wider liquidity, not a param 134 binding.
C17 diagnostic branch from C16 param 143: one-R tight target with score 0.70..0.85 only under ROC20 cooling and controlled sample-recovery bounds.

axis_rationale.c05.raw_setup_guard.close_to_hh20_tolera: Restore sample around breakout bands without accepting far or overextended entries.
axis_rationale.c05.raw_setup_guard.roc20_tolerance: Restore sample around C04 ROC bands without accepting broad momentum chase entries.
axis_rationale.c05.score_component_average_min: Reject imbalanced low-quality candidates even when individual pass count barely passes.
axis_rationale.c05.score_component_min.score_breakout: Require constructive breakout quality while allowing enough sample for monthly evaluation.
axis_rationale.c05.score_component_min.score_momentum: Keep structurally weak trend candidates out without recreating C04 all-component brittleness.
axis_rationale.c05.score_component_min.score_risk: Keep downside-aware ATR/risk quality in candidate selection.
axis_rationale.c05.score_component_min.score_volume: Avoid no-participation picks while keeping moderate volume bucket evidence available.
axis_rationale.c05.score_component_required_pass_count: Require a majority of components to pass instead of all components, addressing C04 sample collapse.
axis_rationale.c05.trend_metric_floor.close_vs_ma20_pct: Avoid entries too far below short moving-average context.
axis_rationale.c05.trend_metric_floor.close_vs_ma50_pct: Avoid entries too far below medium moving-average context.
axis_rationale.c05.trend_metric_floor.rs_20_vs_ihsg: Avoid entries materially lagging the benchmark.
axis_rationale.c05.trend_metric_required_pass_count: Allow one noisy trend field while requiring broad trend health.
axis_rationale.c06.runtime_metric_bounds.atr14_between_: Keeps ATR regime explicit in candidate selection rather than relying only on score contribution.
axis_rationale.c06.runtime_metric_bounds.close_to_hh20_: Keeps entries near the recent range while avoiding far-below reversal traps and overextended breakouts.
axis_rationale.c06.runtime_metric_bounds.dv20_between_c: C01 drilldown showed moderate DV20 buckets outperformed high-liquidity chase; C06 uses the existing strong-DV20 field as an upper cap only for C06.
axis_rationale.c06.runtime_metric_bounds.roc20_between_: Keeps the C01-supported moderate ROC bucket and avoids both weak momentum and high-momentum chase.
axis_rationale.c06.runtime_metric_bounds.vol_ratio_betw: C01 drilldown showed volume 1.2..1.5 was healthier than broad/spike volume; C06 caps volume participation instead of rewarding spikes.
axis_rationale.c06.score_component_average_min: Rejects imbalanced candidates that pass only by one strong component.
axis_rationale.c06.score_component_required_pass_count: Retains C05 soft majority confirmation while the new metric bounds remove known weak buckets.
axis_rationale.c06.trend_metric_required_pass_count: Requires broad trend health while allowing one noisy trend metric.
axis_rationale.c07.confirmation_metric_required_pass_co: Uses soft feature confirmation to avoid C06 sample collapse while filtering C05 weak trades before evaluation.
axis_rationale.c07.event_risk_disallow_flags: Rejects available event-risk flags when present instead of pretending they are absent.
axis_rationale.c07.optional_runtime_metrics.close_to_ll: Avoids reversal traps close to the 20-day low without adding a sector filter or loosening gates.
axis_rationale.c07.optional_runtime_metrics.range_posit: Uses close position inside the 20-day range to avoid both low-range traps and extreme chase.
axis_rationale.c07.optional_runtime_metrics.roc10: Adds entry-timing confirmation between single-month ROC20 and very short-term ROC5.
axis_rationale.c07.optional_runtime_metrics.roc5: Short-term momentum confirmation was available in sealed market-data indicators but not previously propagated into watchlist scoring payloads.
axis_rationale.c07.optional_runtime_metrics.rs_20_vs_se: Requires the stock not to materially lag its own sector.
axis_rationale.c07.optional_runtime_metrics.sector_roc2: Uses sector momentum as confirmation only; it is not a sector whitelist or unsupported sector filter.
axis_rationale.c07.optional_runtime_metrics.sector_rs_2: Requires sector context not to materially lag the benchmark.
axis_rationale.c14.variable_exit_axis.risk.min_rr: C10 showed low target-hit share and many time-expired trades under fixed 1.50R; C14 tests nearer targets without changing locked IS gates.
axis_rationale.c14.variable_exit_axis.risk.stop_atr_mul: C10 showed downside and stop-or-timeout dominance under fixed 1.50 ATR stop; C14 varies stop distance inside C13-authorized bounds only.
axis_rationale.c15.anti_overextension.disallowed_high_m: Rejects high-momentum chase because roc5/roc10/roc20 high buckets were negative in aggregate.
axis_rationale.c15.anti_overextension.disallowed_high_s: Explicitly prevents late-entry score-chase behavior identified by C14 root-cause analysis.
axis_rationale.c15.disallowed_runtime_axes_until_segmen: range_position_20, close_to_ll20, and breakout_extension collapsed into a single diagnostic bucket and are excluded until segmentation is proven.
axis_rationale.c15.runtime_metric_bounds.dv20_between_c: C14 drilldown aggregate showed DV20 2.5B..5B had positive weighted average and healthier win rate; C15 keeps this as candidate-selection range, not as score-only decoration.
axis_rationale.c15.runtime_metric_bounds.roc20_between_: C15 avoids high momentum chase by keeping ROC20 neutral or cooling while still rejecting breakdowns.
axis_rationale.c15.runtime_metric_bounds.vol_ratio_betw: C14 drilldown showed high volume buckets underperformed; C15 caps participation to avoid spike/crowded entries.
axis_rationale.c15.score_total_max: C14 drilldown showed score_bucket 0.9..1 underperformed; C15 caps score_total instead of only raising lower score quantiles.
axis_rationale.c15.short_term_momentum_bounds.roc5.min_: C14 all-row drilldown showed ROC5 -2%..0 was the most consistent positive candidate-selection bucket; C15 implements it as a hard runtime guard.
axis_rationale.c16.quality_preserving_sample_recovery: Sample recovery is limited to modest DV20/volume expansion with the same score/ROC5/ROC20 quality guards; broad C15 rows 129/132 are not used as basis.
axis_rationale.c16.runtime_metric_bounds.vol_ratio_1_5_: C15 evidence showed vol_ratio 1.5..2.0 was the useful bucket while 1.0..1.5 degraded quality; C16 raises the runtime lower bound instead of relying on quantile score decoration.
axis_rationale.c16.score_total_max: C16 caps score_total below 0.8 to avoid the C15-observed 0.8..0.9 overextension bucket and the previously blocked 0.9..1 score chase.
axis_rationale.c16.score_total_min: C16 introduces an explicit absolute score_total floor so the 0.7..0.8 diagnostic rationale is consumed at runtime rather than confused with top_min_score_q.
axis_rationale.c16.score_window.disallowed_score_bucket: Score bucket 0.8..0.9 is rejected as overextended unless future segmented evidence proves otherwise.
axis_rationale.c16.short_term_momentum_bounds.roc5.min_: C16 preserves the C15 controlled pullback ROC5 -2%..0 runtime guard because it was a useful quality signal, not a ticker/month exclusion.
axis_rationale.c17.quality_preserving_sample_recovery_f: C17 is derived from C16 diagnostic anchors 140/134/143/137/141 as direction only; no C16 failed row is promoted as binding.
axis_rationale.c17.runtime_metric_bounds.dv20_2b_to_7_5: C17 explores DV20 2.0B..7.5B as controlled liquidity recovery while keeping row-specific quality segments.
axis_rationale.c17.runtime_metric_bounds.vol_ratio_1_35: C17 lowers the volume floor from C16 only to 1.35 and only with runtime min/strong bounds, not broad low-volume recovery.
axis_rationale.c17.score_chase_0_90_to_1_00_blocked: The prior blocked 0.90..1.00 score-chase space remains disallowed and is not used as sample recovery.
axis_rationale.c17.score_window.segmented_0_65_to_0_80: C17 widens below the C16 0.70 floor only under explicit runtime score-window segmentation to recover sample without using failed-param binding.
axis_rationale.c17.score_window.segmented_0_68_to_0_82: C17 tests a modest score bridge above 0.80 only where the row remains controlled by ROC20/volume/ATR guards.
axis_rationale.c17.score_window.segmented_0_70_to_0_85: C17 allows 0.80..0.85 only in segmented low-ATR or negative-ROC20 setups; 0.85..1.00 remains outside the C17 design.
axis_rationale.c17.volume_1_50_to_2_50_requires_low_atr: The wider 1.50..2.50 volume bucket is limited to low-ATR and negative-ROC20 rows to avoid broad recovery that damaged earlier catalogs.
axis_rationale.grouping.secondary_min_score_q: Tighten or loosen the adaptive SECONDARY cutoff.
axis_rationale.grouping.top_min_score_q: Tighten or loosen the adaptive TOP_PICKS cutoff.
axis_rationale.liquidity.dv20_strong_idr: Reward distinctly strong liquidity without changing the minimum gate.
axis_rationale.risk.atr_ideal_high: Define the upper edge of the preferred entry-volatility band.
axis_rationale.risk.atr_ideal_low: Define the lower edge of the preferred entry-volatility band.
axis_rationale.risk.min_atr14_pct: Reject inactive names unlikely to complete a weekly swing.
axis_rationale.scoring.weights.value.breakout: Tune breakout contribution to entry ranking.
axis_rationale.scoring.weights.value.momentum: Tune momentum contribution to entry ranking.
axis_rationale.scoring.weights.value.risk: Tune volatility-quality contribution to entry ranking.
axis_rationale.scoring.weights.value.volume: Tune participation contribution to entry ranking.
axis_rationale.setup.bo_max_ext_pct: Cap breakout extension to avoid late entries.
axis_rationale.setup.bo_near_below_pct: Control how far below breakout remains a valid near-breakout entry.
axis_rationale.setup.mom_roc20_soft_min: Shape momentum score quality without adding a new hard exit rule.
axis_rationale.volume.strong_vol_ratio: Separate merely tradable volume from strong participation.
